meta.countDisagreements: The Map page still says FTT, OBA, PFT, and PFC use small maps, but the V1.76 update log says PFC was removed and FTT now uses large maps. This dataset follows the newer update log for current mode rules, keeps Icy Landmass as retired because it was exclusive to PFC, and does not include OBA as a row because the current Gamemodes page does not list it as a Roulette minigame.

items.name: Main Map
items.bestFor: Open public fights, item spawns, movement practice, and landmark routes
items.landmarks: Shinjuku Station, Towers, Cafe, Mall, Sewers, stores, and smaller fight buildings
items.itemSpawns: Public items spawn around the map every 10 minutes, with surface and underground spawn dots shown on the Items page.
items.hazards: Most parts are destructible; the train station has a callable train hazard.
items.specialRules: Default public-server fighting area since V1.03.
items.sourcePage: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Map; Gamemodes; Items
items.verificationNote: Map page identifies this as the default public-server map since V1.03. Gamemodes page says Public Servers use the Shinjuku-inspired map and Items page confirms 10-minute public item spawns.

items.name: Towers
items.bestFor: Roof access, vertical fights, billboard panels, and vending-machine routes
items.landmarks: Two 11-floor towers connected by a ninth-floor bridge, roof ladders, billboards, and editing panels on the fourth floors.
items.itemSpawns: Fire extinguishers on the roof and vending machines on the second-to-last floors.
items.hazards: Destroyed ladder sections can collapse the remaining handholds.
items.specialRules: Billboards were added to the towers in V1.44.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone row because it has high-ground routing, vending machines, throwables, and destructible ladder behavior.

items.name: Shinjuku Station
items.bestFor: Item pickup routes, train hazard plays, center-map travel, and underground movement
items.landmarks: Primary and secondary entrances, rails, bathrooms, control room, leaderboards, and underground station paths.
items.itemSpawns: Trash cans, fire extinguishers, vending machines, and nearby underground item-spawn context.
items.hazards: Control panel can call a speeding train that heavily damages players on the rails.
items.specialRules: One control-panel button broadcasts through the station, while the other calls the train.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone row because it has a named hazard, multiple access points, item context, and public-map navigation value.

items.name: Graveyard
items.bestFor: Small-area fights and throwable gravestone routes near the arcade side of the map
items.landmarks: Cemetery on the left side of the arcade with bare trees and marked gravestones.
items.itemSpawns: Throwable gravestones.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible objects.
items.specialRules: Includes the Rika Throw gravestone added after V1.76.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a row because it has a clear current screenshot and throwable landmark value, but it is less important than station, towers, and mall routes.

items.name: Mansion
items.bestFor: Indoor fights, garage movement, and destructible building routes
items.landmarks: Two floors, side garage, small second-floor bedroom, staircase, shelves, and green-screen setup.
items.itemSpawns: Trash can by the bottom of the stairs.
items.hazards: Garage is easy to break in and out of during fights.
items.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone landmark because it is a named current building with a distinct layout and fight route.

items.name: Cafe
items.bestFor: Central fights, dummy practice, vending-machine use, and throwable-chair routes
items.landmarks: Open cafe near the middle plaza with a kitchen, second floor, counters, tables, and tall windows.
items.itemSpawns: Vending machine in the corner, fire extinguisher near the dummy, and throwable chairs.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond destructible cafe objects.
items.specialRules: Dummy always spawns near the entrance.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone row because the source names it as a popular central location and confirms the dummy spawn.

items.name: Unlicensed Studios
items.bestFor: Arcade machines, NEP card pickup, and routes between graveyard and mansion
items.landmarks: Building between the graveyard and mansion with arcade cabinets and a counter area.
items.itemSpawns: Garbage can, NEP card, and vending machine.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
items.specialRules: Arcade cabinets include Catch and Flight as playable machines.
items.sourcePage: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Map; Update Log
items.verificationNote: V1.76 update log says Unlicensed Studios arcade machines no longer cost anything, confirming the location remains active.

items.name: Tze's
items.bestFor: Throwable-heavy indoor fights and routes between Shinjuku Station and Towers
items.landmarks: Restaurant between Shinjuku Station and the Towers with an interior menu board.
items.itemSpawns: One trash can, one fire extinguisher, 16 chairs, a vending machine, and a Nep behind the menu board.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond destructible restaurant objects.
items.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a row because the source gives a clear throwable count and vending/Nep context.

items.name: Jail
items.bestFor: Small-building fights and quick fire-extinguisher pickup
items.landmarks: Light-purple three-story house with a metal-bar jail cell, toilet, and bunk bed.
items.itemSpawns: Fire extinguisher outside the cell.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible objects.
items.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a named current landmark with a clear source image and fire-extinguisher utility.

items.name: Convenience Store
items.bestFor: Soda-machine routes, throwables, and quick indoor scrambles
items.landmarks: Small store with front and side glass double doors, stocked shelves, boxes, and a counter.
items.itemSpawns: Fire extinguisher, trash can, and soda machine near the entrance.
items.hazards: Destroying shelves can cause a small lag spike.
items.specialRules: No special mode rule listed.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a row because it has a soda machine, throwables, and a source-backed lag caveat.

items.name: Comedy Club
items.bestFor: Voice-chat microphone interactions and tight indoor fights
items.landmarks: Single-floor stage house with microphone, speakers, and an interactable piano.
items.itemSpawns: Nep behind the speaker near the exit.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
items.specialRules: Usable microphone requires voice chat access.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a row because the microphone, piano, and Nep are distinct player-facing interactions.

items.name: Court
items.bestFor: Voice-chat speaker interactions and small-room fights
items.landmarks: Small white courthouse with microphones and speakers.
items.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard listed.
items.specialRules: Voice-chat access is needed to use the microphones.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a row because the court has unique interactable microphone/speaker behavior.

items.name: Shenanigans Ball
items.bestFor: Store-to-store routes, escalators, sewer access, and fighting through the mall
items.landmarks: Mall beside Shinjuku Station with escalators, graffiti, JJS Book Store, Sorcerer Appliances, SorceWay, Joyful Jolly Sweets, and nearby sewer access.
items.itemSpawns: Some mall stores include small objects and hidden details, but no separate source-backed item route was strong enough for standalone rows.
items.hazards: No special source-backed hazard beyond normal destructible interiors.
items.specialRules: Minor stores are merged into this parent row because they are too thin as standalone map entries.
items.verificationNote: Merged JJS Book Store, Sorcerer Appliances, SorceWay, and Joyful Jolly Sweets into the mall row to avoid thin landmark cards.

items.name: Bowling Alley
items.bestFor: Void-edge awareness and bowling-ball landmark routes inside the mall
items.landmarks: Bowling lanes, shoe shelves, counter, scoreboards, and imed balls.
items.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
items.hazards: All lanes end with a gap to the void.
items.specialRules: Kept separate from the mall because the lane gap is a clear hazard.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone row because the source-backed void gap changes movement and fights.

items.name: The Sewers
items.bestFor: Underground travel, item-spawn context, and fights with bridges, pillars, and pipes
items.landmarks: Access through the mall store hole or a Shinjuku Station wall route, plus hallways, stairs, bridges, pillars, bars, and a radio.
items.itemSpawns: Items page separates surface and underground spawns, making the sewers important for blue-dot underground routes.
items.hazards: No direct damage hazard listed; tight underground routes can trap movement.
items.specialRules: Do not touch the cheese is source flavor, not treated as a gameplay rule.
items.verificationNote: Kept as a standalone row because it is a current underground route with multiple entrances and item-spawn context.

items.name: Space
items.bestFor: Secret exploration and height-limit curiosity
items.landmarks: Pitch-black space view with stars and Earth visible below.
items.itemSpawns: No source-backed item spawn listed.
items.hazards: No source-backed combat hazard listed.
items.specialRules: Reached by getting to a certain height; going higher only changes the Earth model's apparent size.
items.verificationNote: Kept because it is a named current secret location, not because it is a normal fight arena.

items.name: Tombs of the Star
items.bestFor: Duel practice where spacing matters more than public-map routes
items.landmarks: Small brown island in a white void with one tree.
items.itemSpawns: No public item spawns listed for Duels.
items.hazards: Void-edge awareness; no source-backed public item or train hazard.
items.specialRules: Duels can queue Casual or Ranked, then teleport teams into randomized arenas.
items.verificationNote: Current Map page lists it under Duels. Source image is a placeholder, so no local image was used.

items.name: Detention Center
items.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with high/low platform pressure
items.landmarks: Old hall with a giant hole, raised platforms, lower water-covered area, and ladders back up.
items.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.
items.hazards: Large drop from platforms into the lower water area.
items.specialRules: Gamemodes page says SWP, SRC, FTT, FSD, EOJ, AMS, and SSP use large maps after the V1.76 FTT change.
items.sourcePage: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Map; Gamemodes; Update Log
items.verificationNote: Map page categorizes it as a large map. V1.76 update log moved FTT to large maps and removed PFC.

items.name: Shipping Yard
items.bestFor: Large-map Roulette rounds with container cover and open sightlines
items.landmarks: Stacked containers, cranes, trucks, forklifts, and a broad open yard.
items.itemSpawns: Roulette map, not a normal public item-spawn route.

items.name: Old Map
items.bestFor: Understanding old guides and screenshots that do not match the current Shinjuku map
items.landmarks: Center camp, church, barn, police/fire stations, tower, cabins, hospital, and extra buildings.
items.itemSpawns: Old source notes mention dummies, vending machines, fire extinguishers, and building objects, but this is not current public-map routing.
items.hazards: Lacked barriers on map edges before it was replaced.
items.specialRules: Retired when the current main map replaced it in V1.03.
items.verificationNote: Included only for stale-guide context. Old sublocations are intentionally merged into this parent row.
